roleInfo.name: Traveler
roleInfo.description: You are a Traveler. Figure out the correct answer to the trivia questions without being influenced by the Sneaks!

roleInfo.name: Beacon of Light
roleInfo.description: Everyone knows you are NOT a Sneak. Figure out the correct answer to the trivia questions without being influenced by the Sneaks!

roleInfo.name: Sneak
roleInfo.description: You know who the other Sneaks are. Lead the group astray by getting non-Sneak players to guess the wrong answer to the trivia questions!

value.question: France was still executing people by guillotine when which of these happened?
Cleopatra lived closer in time to which of these events?
options: The construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza

value.question: Oxford University was already teaching students before which of these existed?
Which came first?
Charles Darwin and which other famous figure share the exact same birthday — February 12, 1809?
Nintendo (founded 1889) is older than which of these?
How do butterflies taste food?
options: They don't taste — they smell instead

value.question: What is unique about wombat feces?
options: It glows faintly in the dark

value.question: How long can a garden snail sleep to survive dry conditions?
Which can hold its breath longer underwater?
options: They're roughly equal at about 10 minutes

value.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?
If you shaved a tiger, what would you find underneath?
options: The same stripe pattern on its skin
value.answer: The same stripe pattern on its skin

value.question: What ability have crows been scientifically proven to have?
options: Recognising individual human faces and holding grudges
Counting to at least one hundred
value.answer: Recognising individual human faces and holding grudges

value.question: How do male Gentoo penguins 'propose' to a potential mate?
options: By presenting a carefully selected pebble
By catching and offering a live fish
value.answer: By presenting a carefully selected pebble

value.question: What is true about Venus?
options: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus
Venus has the longest year in the solar system
Venus is the hottest because it's the closest planet to the Sun
value.answer: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus

value.question: What do scientists believe it rains on Neptune and Uranus?
Which of these numbers is larger?
options: The number of possible unique chess games
The number of atoms in the observable universe
value.answer: The number of possible unique chess games

value.question: Under the right conditions, which freezes faster?
options: They always freeze at exactly the same rate

value.question: What happens to astronauts' height during spaceflight?
options: They grow up to 2 inches taller
Their height stays exactly the same
value.answer: They grow up to 2 inches taller

value.question: The Eiffel Tower changes height with the seasons. By how much?
options: It doesn't — it's specially sealed to prevent this

value.question: Which US state is simultaneously the most eastern AND most western state in the country?
How many countries lie between Finland and North Korea?
Which country has the most time zones?
What was the chainsaw originally invented for?
options: To cut through jungle undergrowth on expeditions

value.question: What was tomato ketchup sold as in the 1830s?
What did the original Coca-Cola contain that was removed in 1903?
The word 'muscle' comes from the Latin for...
What is the technical name for the dot over the letters 'i' and 'j'?
What is the official technical name for the # symbol?
What is Scotland's official national animal?
The shortest war in recorded history lasted less than an hour. Who was fighting?
The Canary Islands are not named after the bird. What are they actually named after?
options: A yellow flower native to the islands

value.question: What was lobster considered in colonial America?
options: Poor people's food, fed to prisoners and servants
A sacred food avoided by European settlers
A luxury reserved for visiting royalty
value.answer: Poor people's food, fed to prisoners and servants

value.question: The Statue of Liberty was originally designed for...
options: The entrance to the Suez Canal in Egypt
The port of Marseille in France
The mouth of the River Thames in London
value.answer: The entrance to the Suez Canal in Egypt

value.question: What did Al Capone's older brother do for a living?
options: He was a Prohibition agent who hunted bootleggers
He ran a rival gang in Chicago
value.answer: He was a Prohibition agent who hunted bootleggers

value.question: How many people were officially recorded as dying in the Great Fire of London (1666), which destroyed 13,000 houses?
The inventor of the frontal lobotomy (a brutal procedure later banned worldwide)...
options: Was eventually imprisoned for practicing it
Publicly disavowed it before he died

value.question: Why is a software error called a 'bug'?
options: An actual moth was found stuck inside an early computer
Early code was written on paper that attracted beetles
It comes from 'buggy', meaning poorly made
value.answer: An actual moth was found stuck inside an early computer

value.question: Which of these is botanically classified as a true berry?
Which letter of the alphabet does not appear in any US state name?
Which commonly stated 'fact' is actually false?
options: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye
value.answer: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye

value.question: Which of these is true?
options: Humans share about 60% of their DNA with bananas
Humans share about 60% of their DNA with chimpanzees
No plant shares more than 10% of its DNA with humans
value.answer: Humans share about 60% of their DNA with bananas

value.question: The longest recorded case of hiccups lasted...
In the US, which kills more people per year?
Which of these comparisons is true?
options: There are more tigers in Texas than left in the entire wild worldwide
There are more wild lions than wild tigers
There are more captive pandas than wild ones
value.answer: There are more tigers in Texas than left in the entire wild worldwide

value.question: Which of these was once an Olympic sport?
What happened to Ed Headrick, the inventor of the modern Frisbee, after he died?
options: His ashes were molded into memorial Frisbees
He was buried with his full Frisbee collection
His estate donated all Frisbee patents to charity
value.answer: His ashes were molded into memorial Frisbees

value.question: What happened to Fred Baur, the inventor of the Pringles can, after he died?
options: His ashes were buried in a Pringles can
He was buried with the original prototype
The Pringles company named a flavor after him
value.answer: His ashes were buried in a Pringles can

value.question: The actors who voiced Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse for decades...
options: Were married to each other in real life
Had a famous feud behind the scenes
value.answer: Were married to each other in real life
